title: Ijwi rivuye mu gisaka kigurumana
intro: Gusobanura akaranga k’umuntu w’agaciro kanini urugendo rwiwe rwatanguye n’uguhura kw’igitangaza, kandi iherezo ryiwe ryari rifatanye n’ukubohora kw’abantu bacitse intege. Uwo muntu yatowe kugira ngo akore igikorwa gikomeye cane, ahanganye n’ingorane zikomeye cane ashigikiwe n’Imana.
clues: Navukiye mu gihe c’agahahazo gakomeye, aho abana b’inzoya bo mu bwoko bwanje bariko baricwa.
Ubuzima bwanje bwa kera bwari ubwo gushirwa mu ruzi n’umuvyeyi wanje, yamara narabonetse kandi ndakurira mu rugo nyene rw’umunyarugomo w’abantu banje.
Igihe kimwe narahunga igisagara kimwe maze gutuma umuntu apfa ata co nshaka mu gihe bariko baratongana.
Nararonse ubutumwa buva ku Mana n’inkoni y’igitangaza mu kibanza ceranda, aho nategetswe guhangana n’umutware w’inkomezi.
Murumuna wanje yarashinzwe kuba umufasha wanje mu butumwa bwanje, kubera ikintu mbona ko kimpagaritse umutima mu mvugo yanje.
Narongoye abantu banje ndajabuka ikiyaga cacitsemwo ibice, nkingira ingabo z’agahahazo.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verse: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]." (20:77)
